title: The Forest Express
subtitle: To welcome the unexpected good luck, clean your chimney so it won't get stuck.

trails.title: Projector Relay Controller
trails.description: To sort out the mess takes certain patience.

items.text: The Forest Express
Guest Room, St. Foundation

items.speaker: X
items.text: Alright, here are ... 30 cans of Dr. Papper, 20 bags of Happy Wedges, 11 bags of Big Foot Gummy, and a bottle of insect repellent for plants.
Just as he finishes the sentence, a heavy box falls through the chimney, weightily landing in the fireplace.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Oh, good timing.

items.speaker: X
items.text: There may be a bit of ash on them, but the flavor and texture should still be fine.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ugh ... *coughs*

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The ash is killing me. That's way more than a bit ...

items.speaker: X
items.text: I can't just carry them with me in broad daylight. Do you know how many procedures I have gone through just to pay you a visit?

items.speaker: X
items.text: But how come you are locked in the same room? Since when has the Foundation become so benevolent?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: They would like Captain to guide me to the right path ... to join the Foundation. After all, Captain was already a member of them.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Yep. But I don't feel any difference in the benefits I get! At best, I could contact someone from the outside ... and you're here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So? Texas Hold'em?

items.speaker: X
items.text: That's not what I'm here for.

items.speaker: X
items.text: I've shown you the "Storm" records these years. So did you find anything?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hmm ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You call it a record, but it's so brief that it only has start time and duration ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I can't tell any pattern from that!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe believes that the "Storm," which happens randomly, does not conform to the self-adjusting nature of the universe.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Self-adjusting ... Hmm …

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Is that the theory you mentioned before? Something like "there should be someone who intervenes or improves the system in order to reduce the growth of the instability of the universe" ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: For example, if the universe is a mooring rope ... no, a bunch of ropes ... there has to be a sailor who pulls the ropes to keep them in order or something.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Sounds like the cosmology from centuries ago ...
He doesn't seem keen on the theory, nor does he repel it; he just quickly spins on his heels without saying a word.

items.speaker: X
items.text: But your metaphor reminds me of Madam Z's research on string theory.

items.speaker: X
items.text: She advocates that the energy string is the most basic unit of the universe.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Are you talking about Vertin's boss?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Boss?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Well, if that's your definition of immediate supervisor, then yes.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Madam Z was a scientist who studied in Britain before she joined the Foundation.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ooh. Bread and honey are the staff of life. That makes sense.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Well, it's not a good choice for most scientists.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Recently she has been promoted from the chief of the vice president's staff to a formal member of the Committee. I guess she will spend even less time in the lab ...
A sudden, violent bump comes from outside the door.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Uhhh ...!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The whole building shakes. Did something hit it?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Let me see.
Looking out of the window, they see a giant oak, cut down from its bottom, leaning on the hallway of the second floor.
Among its ever-growing branches stands a familiar figure in a black dress. A young teenager with a hat, waggling and swaying on a branch, follows her.
Summoned by a peculiar chanting, more and more trees grow up from the ground, stretch, and spread in mid-air.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Is that Druvis? And ... Sotheby?
He turns around, looking serious.

items.speaker: X
items.text: What's this? Guys ...

items.speaker: X
items.text: I am not gonna be dragged into a riot at this point.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ah ... Is that Druvis? What happened to her?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: ... Her new hairstyle is sort of cool.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, that's not the point.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Agreed, not the point at all. I gotta go. If you want me to take part in such an event, my name should never be in the visitor log.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Looks like the whole building will be your battlefield ...

items.speaker: X
items.text: Alright, good luck.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wait a minute!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: If we join Druvis ... what would happen?

items.speaker: X
items.text: What would happen? I'm not a prophet.

items.speaker: X
items.text: But this is gonna be the best spot for protest.

items.speaker: X
items.text: This building is the furthest one from the center of the Foundation. On the first and second floors are material rooms and research offices. Few staff stay here.

items.speaker: X
items.text: The room next to yours is the projection lab.

items.speaker: X
items.text: It was used to control the slides projected in the lobby. That screen is gone now, but the transfer devices and circuits are still there.

items.speaker: X
items.text: You know what? If you're going to protest ... make it loud.

items.speaker: X
items.text: It's been a long time since the Foundation had something this much fun.
He pulls out the one sleeve in Regulus's grip and quickly exits the room.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ms. Druvis, is Vertin having a fight with the Foundation?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... Yes.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: We have a disagreement with the Foundation, Ms. Sotheby.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Vertin is seeking a limited freedom for us. Her aspiration is to restore the peaceful life before the "Storm."

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: For the authorities, however, her aspiration and ambition are labeled as deviation and rebellion.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: We are thus tempted, alienated, and arrested unjustly.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: That's why we've been grounded all these days ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: So we're helping Vertin now, is that right, Ms. Druvis?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I really feel like doing something for her ...! Just like what I'm doing right now, standing brave on the tree!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Right. On the tree.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: We need to move forward, to move one step further.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: When we meet up with Regulus and APPLe, our voices will be stronger, and more and more people will offer their help.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I believe that when the day comes, we will be able to shake up the balance in the Foundation and tilt it to our side.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Shake up the balance ... Wow ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Maybe Vertin will come back herself by then!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I got it! Now my goal is to make more potions, so the trees can grow larger and larger, make them super large!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: This is going to be a protracted war of resistance.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: After we rescue Regulus, please maintain our territory of the woods with the rest of your potions, Ms. Sotheby.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Sure! I will economize on them!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Look, X is coming out of the room!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: He left. It seems he has made his choice.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Not helping us or them ... Well, at least no one is getting hurt from the boiling pot this time.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Let me see. Hmm, there are more guards at the door now! It seems everyone's there!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Perhaps they have guessed our next move ... Regulus.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Let's go. It's time to meet up with our companions.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Go, go! Regulus must be bored to death just as I was!
Druvis raises her wand.
As the chant goes on, her hair has become increasingly glistening gold.
The oaks march on like waves. Their bud scales keep growing, extending, chasing, and overlapping each other, and their crowns shoot forward like missiles.

items.speaker: Guard II
items.text: Watch out! Incoming!

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: Everyone, get ready to engage!
TO BE CONTINUED…
